description: Single with investment income only: personal exemption, everything at 5%
working: Income = 20,000 interest + 20,000 dividends (Part B, 5%) + 10,000 long-term gains (Part C, 5%) = 50,000. No wages, so no Social Security/Medicare deduction. Personal exemption (single) = 4,400; with no other Part B income the excess exemption carries to the 5% income. Taxable = 50,000 - 4,400 = 45,600. Tax = 45,600 x 5% = 2,280. Below the surtax threshold.
